finalText:
Build passes now, exit code `0`.

Two real bugs hid in that warning wall. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes `retryCount`. It reads either shape now and defaults to `0`. Behind it, `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset `backoffEnabled` flag. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. It treats unset as off, matching the old default.

The remaining warnings are noise. They are hardcoded strings inside `build.js` itself. They name files like `src/legacy/adapter.js` that do not exist here. Nothing in your source can clear them.
